verdict.rationale: The docs say nix-shell only builds or downloads dependencies 'if they're not already in your Nix store'. That implies a single shared store reused across projects. Packages live in distinct versioned paths, so multiple versions coexist without overwriting, and a community comment confirms store directories are hash-named. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of content-addressing and cross-project deduplication (e.g., store path hashing or store optimisation/hard-linking), and independent hands-on corroboration of disk savings.
